fields.subject: ShardsValues
fields.where: the invoked overload is one of the two List<> forms whose records parameter is one key-component narrower than its own generic type parameters: ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild>(short shardId, List<ShardKey<TRecord>> records) at ShardsValues.cs line 255, or ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>(short shardId, List<ShardKey<TRecord>> records) at line 324
fields.condition: the records argument is non-null and its actual runtime type is a caller-supplied subclass of List<ShardKey<TRecord>> that separately implements the wider IList<ShardKey<TRecord, TChild>> (or, for the three-level overload, IList<ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>>) interface the forwarding cast targets — not true of a plain List<ShardKey<TRecord>> instance, but possible because List<T> is not sealed
fields.response: the forwarding cast to the wider interface succeeds, and execution forwards into the IList<> overload at line 265 (ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild>(short, IList<ShardKey<TRecord, TChild>>)) or line 337 (ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>(short, IList<ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>>)), which iterates records and builds a ShardsValues containing one entry for each distinct ShardId found in records that is not equal to the supplied shardId
fields.postcondition: the returned ShardsValues's Shards dictionary holds exactly one empty entry per distinct foreign shard identifier present in records (the supplied shardId itself excluded), and no exception is thrown
